title: fix(cache): normalize keys for lookup
body:
## Rationale
Callers use different capitalization for keys, causing misses against a store whose keys are already lowercase.

## Testing
Validation has not been performed; test selection is pending.

## Limitations
Unrelated features remain outside scope; risk assessment is pending.

## Breaking changes
No signature change; key matching becomes case-insensitive for lookup.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/cache.py b/src/cache.py
--- a/src/cache.py
+++ b/src/cache.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def lookup(store, key):
-    return store.get(key)
+    return store.get(key.lower())

diff --git a/tests/test_cache.py b/tests/test_cache.py
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_cache.py
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+from src.cache import lookup
+
+
+def test_lookup():
+    assert lookup({'user': 7}, 'USER') == 7
+    assert lookup({'user': 7}, 'user') == 7
